title: US-11 DFD: manage the shopping list

flows.label: List query, item name or deletion id and access token
Owned shopping entries and existence data

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
A blank name yields 400 without list changes. List reads return the owned items or empty array. New items return 201.
Owner/name uniqueness is the existing D-07 deduplication rule; repeated normalized names retain the existing entry. Missing deletion targets return 404 and foreign targets 403/404.
No inventory write occurs: recipe, shopping, favorite and history actions never deduct or restock fridge ingredients.
